title: Sarasota’s ‘Freezing’ Winter
text:
Sarasota residents sometimes describe winter days as freezing. But “cold” depends on what your body is used to. For someone from Mongolia, a Sarasota winter day can look much more like a mild or even summery day at home.
Choose any Sarasota day below. Winter dates are grouped at the top of the menu so you can focus on the days Sarasota residents may call “freezing.” The comparison finds the day in Ulaanbaatar with the closest daily average air temperature.

title: Mongolia
text:
Key pattern
Mongolia has a much colder winter and a sharper seasonal temperature swing than Sarasota. Rainfall is relatively low overall, but the climate still shows a clear warm-season pulse.

title: Exploration
text:
Choose a city and measure from the menu inside the chart. The date-range slider lets you focus on a particular part of 2023. The readings are hourly observations, so zooming in reveals changes across individual hours rather than daily averages.


                            
                                            


Use the menu to compare the two cities and switch between temperature and rainfall. Try narrowing the slider to winter or summer to see when the two places differ most.

Key pattern
Sarasota stays relatively warm throughout the year, with higher rainfall during the warmer months and a gentler winter climate compared with Ulaanbaatar.

title: UB Weather Dashboard
text: How does the world’s coldest national capital compare to sunny Florida? Explore 2023 temperature and rainfall patterns between Sarasota, FL and Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

title: UB Weather Dashboard
text:
Hourly Temperature Comparison


                            
                                            


Notice how Ulaanbaatar drops far below 32°F in winter and rises to warm summer highs, while Sarasota stays relatively mild all year.
